target_customer: Fashion brands, SMBs and independent designers
problem: Turning fashion designs into factory-ready patterns and tech packs is manual and slow.
product_category: AI fashion pattern and product engineering software

founders.name: Yuliya Raquel
founders.background_notes: YC page gives no education or employers.

technical_complexity.rationale: Parametric pattern generation from measurements is standard CAD-style engineering with some hard parts; no deeper evidence opened.

defensibility.rationale: Established CAD tools such as CLO3D and Browzwear exist (named on the YC page as compatible tools); a patent-pending claim on the old site was not verified.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not established; company later rebranded to PatternFast and is still active.

market_need_then: Not sourced for 2019. Current pitch cites savings of $20M or more for large fashion corporations (YC page, a company claim).

rebrands.why: Not stated; positioning moved to speed and manufacturing.

brand_strength.rationale: Two renames and no brand evidence found.

pivots.to: AI product engineering layer for manufacturers (PatternFast)
pivots.why: Not stated in sources; date unknown.

outcome_analysis: Tailornova/Couturme entered YC in W19 and later rebranded as PatternFast, now an active early stage company with 23 people per YC and an AI manufacturing positioning. Funding is only reported by aggregators as small, so the trajectory is unclear. No source explains the renaming or the date, so success or stall cannot be judged.
notes: Funding unverified: aggregators report $500K seed in May 2025 (VCBacked, FundedIQ, DevCuration), Dealroom $125K seed, Seedtable about $775K for the Tailornova profile. No round recorded because no primary or cross-checked figure was opened. YC page says founded 2024 while company is W19; founded_year left null. Competitor lists found were 2026 directory pages so the list is empty. The company website patternfast.com was not fetched.
